name: FMLARYNX
author: Presethead
tagline: A talking formant synth for the FM-1
description: A throaty talking formant synth with a 303-style pattern sequencer: a saw wave through a three-formant vowel filter with an envelope, a resonant low-pass, drive and ping-pong delay. 16 steps with vowels, accent and slide per step, a pattern randomizer and 16 stored patterns.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
